topics.title_zh: OpenAI发表论文证明矩阵乘法指数精确为9/4
topics.title_en: OpenAI publishes a preprint that claims to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4, addressing a major open problem in mathematics (alphaXiv)
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI发布预印本论文，从理论层面证明了矩阵乘法指数的下界为9/4，解决了数学界长期悬而未决的复杂性问题
topics.summary_en: OpenAI published a preprint proving that the square matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4 over any field. Utilizing formal arithmetic circuits and proof by contradiction, the research bridges matrix multiplication efficiency with lower bounds on network compression costs, filling a critical gap in asymptotic rank and unrestricted circuit complexity.

perspective_pro.point_en: Extended reasoning represents a historic step in exploring mathematical conjectures, opening a new paradigm for scientific discovery.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 严谨学界 / 理论数学家

perspective_con.point_zh: 论文正文存在大量逻辑断层与形式主义幻觉，用概率自相关拼凑严谨数理证明极具欺骗性，缺乏确定性严密结论。
perspective_con.point_en: The submission exhibits critical logical disconnects and formal hallucinations, failing to satisfy the rigorous standards of mathematical proof.
